title: Sphere Packing in ℝ⁸ (Viazovska): Periodic Packing Constant & E₈ Optimality
description: Full-repository Lean 4 module-system (`allow_module_system: true`) snapshot from thefundamentaltheor3m/Sphere-Packing-Lean (commit 072d555d, Lean v4.36.0, Apache-2.0 — the final v4.36.0 commit before the v4.37.0-rc1 toolchain bump). Closes two blueprint-backed foundational obligations: proving the periodic sphere packing constant equals the general sphere packing constant in all dimensions d > 0 (`periodic_constant_eq_constant`), and Viazovska's Fields-Medal E₈ optimality theorem (`SpherePacking.MainTheorem`), verified against 6 sorry-free prebuilt upstream `.olean` dependencies plus the `SpherePacking.Basic.E8` bridge.

tasks.title: Prove periodic sphere packing constant equals general sphere packing constant
tasks.description: Closes the sole open `sorry` in `SpherePacking/Basic/PeriodicPacking.lean:1219-1221` (`periodic_constant_eq_constant`): for every dimension `d > 0`, prove `PeriodicSpherePackingConstant d = SpherePackingConstant d` with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `thefundamentaltheor3m/Sphere-Packing-Lean@072d555d`.

tasks.title: Prove E₈ realizes optimal sphere packing density in ℝ⁸ (`SpherePacking.MainTheorem`)
tasks.description: Closes `SpherePacking.MainTheorem` at `SpherePacking/MainTheorem.lean:15-16`: prove `SpherePackingConstant 8 = E8Packing.density` (Viazovska's 2016 theorem in ℝ⁸, building on `periodic_constant_eq_constant` via `SpherePacking.Basic.E8`) with 0 sorry and standard axioms only. Accepted patches apply directly upstream to `thefundamentaltheor3m/Sphere-Packing-Lean@072d555d`.
